data.name: Kritsana
data.detailed_description:
Inspect retro CCTV footage to uncover the truth behind a psychiatric patient's hallucinations in this Thai-inspired psychological horror anomaly observation game.

Monitor surveillance cameras across multiple locations, identify anomalies, and report them before the situation spirals out of control. Every recording reveals unsettling details that blur the line between psychological trauma and the supernatural.

Story

Thailand, 1997.

Kritsana, a psychiatric patient suffering from severe hallucinations and paranoia, refuses to accept his doctor's diagnosis. He believes the figures tormenting him are not symptoms of mental illness, but real spirits haunting his everyday life.

Determined to prove the truth, Kritsana records CCTV footage from places familiar to him and sends the tapes to his psychiatrist, Dr. Thanapat, hoping the doctor will finally witness what he sees.

You are tasked with reviewing these old VHS recordings. Observe every corner carefully, because what you are about to witness may force you to question whether this is merely a psychiatric disorder... or something far more disturbing.

Your Objectives

  • Monitor CCTV cameras across multiple locations.

  • Report every anomaly you discover.

  • Observe until 05:00 AM.

You will fail if you

  • Make 3 consecutive false reports.

  • Allow 4 active anomalies to exist simultaneously.

Controls

A / D or ← / → Keys - Switch CCTV cameras 

Hold Left Click - Report an anomaly

English*, Spanish - Spain, Thai*, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese, French, German, Russian
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 64-bit CPU with SSE4.2 support
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU with OpenGL 3.3 support (Integrated graphics supported)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 64-bit CPU with SSE4.2 support
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU with OpenGL 3.3 support (Integrated graphics supported)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 (Big Sur) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or later
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3 / OpenGL ES 3.0 compatible GPU
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 11 (Big Sur) or later
  • Processor: Apple Silicon (M1 or later)
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple Silicon GPU
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains depictions of horror, violence, and gore, including decapitated figures/ghosts and blood effects.
